enchantments.tooltip: +6 Enhancement Bonus: +6 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Acid Blast 4: This weapon is covered in a strong and deadly acid, dealing 4d6 Acid damage on a successful hit, and an additional 4d6 Acid damage on a critical hit.

Improved Deception: This item makes your weapons hard to focus upon and thus provides a +5 enhancement bonus to Bluff checks. In addition, while using this item your weapons have a chance to envelop the target in darkness, making them vulnerable to sneak attacks for a short time.
Dusk: Equipping this item engulfs you in twilight shadows. Attacks from enemies have a 10% chance to miss you due to concealment.
Critical Weakening 2: This deadly weapon saps the power and might from your enemies, dealing 2 Strength damage on each critical hit.

Improved Paralyzing : Any creature struck by this weapon must succeed on a DC 28 Will save or be paralyzed. The target may attempt a new save to end the effect every several seconds; otherwise the paralysis lasts for 1 minute.
